source_status: Milestone 10A evidence is reconciled through the Phase 10 revision-matched local gate, isolated normal/QA runtime proof, consecutive CI proof, draft-PR publication, and PLAN_PASS finalization. The pre-merge stabilization adds the V024 administrator-managed target-origin contract; the visual portal, architecture report, API catalog/handbook, beginner manual, workflow guide, feature/business-logic handbook, and implementation/testing notes describe the current V001-V024 source contract.
